en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, and Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Al Qasim Bin Urwat, from Ibn Bukeyr, from Zurara, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Regarding the hand is half the wergild; and regarding the two hands together is the (complete) wergild; and regarding the two feet is similar to that; and regarding the manhood when the tip is cut off, and what is above that, is the (complete) wergild; and regarding the nose when the soft parts are cut off, is the (complete) wergild; and regarding the two lips is the (complete) wergild; and regarding the two eyes is the (complete) wergild, and regarding of the two is half the wergild’.
